1284-2060-4687.notablePrerequisites: Crystalline Crawler has at least four counters on it.
1284-2060-4687.description:
Activate Viridian Longbow by tapping Gilder Bairn, producing its effect.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least three mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Crystalline Crawler, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

1429-2099-3545.description:
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Lesser Masticore
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters, Sigil Captain triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat.

1349-2034-6854.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional nontoken creature with a coin counter on it.
1349-2034-6854.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature with a coin counter on it, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Athreos's second ability and Host of the Hereafter's ability trigger.
Resolve the Host of the Hereafter trigger, putting a coin counter onto itself as well as +1/+1 counters if those were present.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Host of the Hereafter, adding {C}{C}.
When Host of the Hereafter dies, it and Athreos's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Host of the Hereafter trigger, putting a coin counter and +1/+1 counters onto the other nontoken creature.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning Host of the Hereafter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

215-3499-5709.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Forests.
215-3499-5709.description:
Activate Rofellos by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Rofellos from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Rofellos by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2211-4508-7746.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
2211-4508-7746.description:
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
HYDRA Assault Robot triggers, dealing 1 damage to target opponent.
Malcolm triggers, as HYDRA Assault Robot is a Pirate due to Captain's Hook, creating a Treasure token
When the Treasure enters, HYDRA Assault Robot triggers, dealing 1 damage to target opponent.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

2313-3099-4762-7741.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Conclave Mentor and Shang-Chi.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

2724-3080-5299-7638.description:
Cast Exchange of Words by paying {1}{U}{U}.
When Exchange of Words enters the battlefield, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of it and Wormfang Manta.
At the beginning of your end step, The Mind Stone triggers, blinking Exchange of Words.
Exchange of Words leaves and enters the battlefield, triggering the second ability it gained from Wormfang Manta's textbox as well as its own ability.
Resolve the first Exchange of Words trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the second Exchange of Words trigger, exchanging the text boxes of it and Wormfang Manta.
Repeat from step 3 during each turn.

2730-3175-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

2292-5170-6132-6559.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Venerated Stormsinger triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Venerated Stormsinger trigger.
Resolve the Venerated Stormsinger trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

2079-4644-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Tidewater Minion.
Activate one of the Tidewater Minion tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Tidewater Minion token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

149-2757-3901--143.description:
Earthbend a basic land you control.
Cast Legolas's Quick Reflexes by paying {G}, targeting the earthbent land.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the earthbent land, targeting the earthbent land.
The land triggers, causing it to deal damage equal to its power to Wrathful Red Dragon.
Wrathful Red Dragon triggers, dealing that much damage to an applicable target.
Resolve the Earthcraft trigger, untapping the earthbent land.
Repeat from step 3.
149-2757-3901--143.notes: The {G} in the mana cost can be waived if you earthbend a Forest and tap it for mana before casting Legolas's Quick Reflexes. You may need additional mana to earthbend the land depending on the method of earthbending used.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3334-3899-4552-4694.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat

1170-1328-4251-7060.notablePrerequisites:
You have an instant card exiled by Spellbinder's imprint ability that has legal targets, if needed.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Spellbinder attached to any Samurai you control.
1170-1328-4251-7060.description:
Declare Godo and the creature with Spellbinder attached as attackers.
Godo's second ability triggers, causing you to untap it and all Samurai you control, and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Spellbinder attached.
Spellbinder triggers, causing you to copy a card exiled with it, and cast the copy without paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Godo.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the spell cast in step 4.
Repeat each combat phase.

141-2921-6818.description:
Cast Return to Action by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Return to Action, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Return to Action.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Bartolomé del Presidio abilities from step 5.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 3 or greater

486-1978-3717.description:
Cause Viridian Joiner to become an artifact using Liquimetal Torque.
Activate Viridian Joiner by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Viridian Joiner.
Repeat from step 2.

1414-2866-2981-4986.description:
Cast Lotus Petal by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Lotus Petal from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Repeat.

3647-3821-4863.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
3647-3821-4863.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Displace by paying {2}{U}, blinking Revolutionist and Peregrine Drake
When Revolutionist and Peregrine Drake enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Revolutionist trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Repeat.
3647-3821-4863.notes: If you control five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Peregrine Drake.

2034-2173-5220-6539.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Willow Geist.
When Willow Geist dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Willow Geist from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Willow Geist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Cast Willow Geist from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Bolas's Citadel.
Repeat.

997-1263-2060-6701.description:
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.
997-1263-2060-6701.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana needed to activate the creature's ability from your graveyard.

1808-2292-3000.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another creature you control.
Eloise's first ability triggers, and Eloise's second ability triggers if the creature was a token.
Resolve the first trigger, creating a Clue token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Resolve the second trigger, if applicable, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

325-2275-5014-6282.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You have at least one card in hand.
325-2275-5014-6282.description:
Activate Putrid Imp by discarding a card.
Toluz's second ability triggers, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Shabraz triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Shabraz.
Resolve the Putrid Imp ability.
Repeat.

647-2105-3204-4364.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Aurelia.
Mysterious Limousine does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
One of Aurelia or Combat Celebrant must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mysterious Limousine.
647-2105-3204-4364.description:
Declare either Aurelia or Combat Celebrant and Mysterious Limousine as attackers.
Mysterious Limousine and either Aurelia or Combat Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Aurelia or Combat Celebrant trigger, untapping Mysterious Limousine and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Mysterious Limousine trigger, exiling Aurelia or Combat Celebrant from the battlefield, and then returning Aurelia or Combat Celebrant from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

997-2781-5987.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying {3}{W}
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Angel of Indemnity.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian ability, blinking Angel of Indemnity.
When Angel of Indemnity enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2 any number of times.
Resolve all abilities from step 3, scrying 1 any number of times.

1479-2719-3147.description:
Play Azorius Chancery.
Kodama of the East Tree, Sakashima of a Thousand Faces, and Azorius Chancery trigger.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Azorius Chancery onto the battlefield.
Sakashima of a Thousand Faces and Azorius Chancery trigger.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces token's trigger, putting Azorius Chancery onto the battlefield.
Kodama of the East Tree and Azorius Chancery trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

1061-1576-3963.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U} the first turn, with {3}{U}{U}{U} available each extra turn
1061-1576-3963.notablePrerequisites:
Meneldor does not have summoning sickness. An opponent cannot block Meneldor.
You have the city's blessing.
You have an effect that grants Timestream Navigator haste each turn.
1061-1576-3963.description:
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping and putting it on the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent with Meneldor.
Meneldor triggers, blinking Forerunner of the Coalition.
Forerunner of the Coalition enters, triggering its first ability, causing you to search your library for Timestream Navigator and put it on top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Timestream Navigator during your draw phase.
Cast Timestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}.
Timestream Navigator enters the battlefield, triggering Forerunner of the Coalition's second ability, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.
1061-1576-3963.notes: This loop will only continue as long as you can deal combat damage with Meneldor.

1376-3457-4235.notablePrerequisites:
Priest of Titania and Seeker of Skybreak do not have summoning sickness.
There are at least three Elves on the battlefield.
1376-3457-4235.description:
Activate Priest of Titania by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting itself.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Priest of Titania.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Priest of Titania.
Repeat.

618-2178-3381.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Morgue Toad with haste.
Activate the Morgue Toad token by sacrificing it, adding {U}{R}.
When the Morgue Toad token dies, Kiki-Jiki triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

1631-3771-4050-5220.notablePrerequisites: Animar has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
1631-3771-4050-5220.description:
Cast Battalion Foot Soldier by paying {W}.
Animar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
When Battalion Foot Soldier enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Battalion Foot Soldier, adding {W}.
When Battalion Foot Soldier dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Battalion Foot Soldier on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Battalion Foot Soldier trigger from step 2, searching your library for Battalion Foot Soldier and putting it into your hand.
Repeat.

575-861-2034.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one white card in hand.
575-861-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Watcher of the Roost, adding {C}{C}.
When Watcher of the Roost dies, Yedora triggers, returning Watcher of the Roost from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Activate Watcher of the Roost by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Watcher of the Roost's morph ability by revealing a white card from your hand, turning it face up.
Watcher of the Roost triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

579-654-774-2137.notablePrerequisites: High Tide in hand.You control at least two mana-producing lands.
579-654-774-2137.description:
Cast any instant or sorcery spell by paying its mana cost, or wait for an opponent to cast one.
Holding priority, activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}.
Holding priority, activate Uyo by paying {2} and returning two lands to your hand, copying the instant or sorcery.
Resolve the copy of the instant or sorcery.
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting two lands from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers twice, untapping them.
Repeat from step 2.

11-146-2103.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal, choosing to pay its replicate cost once, by paying a total of {U}{U}{U}{U}, targeting Capture of Jingzhou.
Narset's Reversal's replicate ability triggers, creating a copy of it targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, creating a copy of the original Narset's Reversal targeting Capture of Jingzhou and returning the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the second copy of Narset's Reversal, creating a copy of Capture of Jingzhou and returning the original Capture of Jingzhou to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Capture of Jingzhou, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

122-372-1545-4050.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian by paying {4}{W}.
Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Trostani.
Resolve the Trostani trigger, causing you to gain life equal to Abdel Adrian's toughness.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Phyrexian Delver until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
The Soldier enters the battlefield, triggering Trostani, causing you to gain life equal to the Soldier's toughness.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Abdel Adrian, adding one mana of any color.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, causing Phyrexian Delver to return to the battlefield from exile.
Phyrexian Delver enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Trostani.
Resolve the Trostani trigger, causing you to gain life equal to Phyrexian Delver's toughness.
Resolve the Phyrexian Delver trigger, returning Abdel Adrian from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose five life.
Repeat from step 2.

190-389-566.description:
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, exiling Nine Lives and causing each opponent to create a token copy of it.
Nine Lives triggers. Holding priority, cast Tempest of Light by paying its mana cost, destroying all enchantments.
Each opponent's Nine Lives leaves the battlefield, causing them to lose the game.

1109-4447.notablePrerequisites:
Assault Suit attached to Skeleton Ship.
A player controls no Islands.
1109-4447.description:
If needed, give control of Skeleton Ship to an opponent who controls no Islands.
When Skeleton Ship's controller controls no Islands, Skeleton Ship triggers, causing them to sacrifice it.
However, Skeleton Ship cannot be sacrificed due to Assault Suit.
Skeleton Ship triggers again, creating a mandatory infinite loop that causes the game to end in a draw.

527-2635-3716.notablePrerequisites: Selvala does not have summoning sickness.
527-2635-3716.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding an amount of {R} equal to the greatest power among creatures you control.
Cast Fanning the Flames with buyback by paying a total of at least {5}{R}{R}.
Raggadragga's third ability triggers, untapping Selvala and giving it +7/+7 until end of turn.
Resolve Fanning the Flames, dealing at least 2 damage to any target and returning it to your hand.
Repeat.

2320-3368-4462-4673.notablePrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
You control lands that can tap to add at least {5}{R}{R}.
2320-3368-4462-4673.description:
Cast Firemind's Foresight by paying {5}{U}{R}, searching for Lightning Bolt, Reset, and Reiterate.
Cast Reset by paying {U}{U}.
Holding priority, cast Reiterate with buyback by paying {4}{R}{R}, creating a copy of Reset.
Resolve the Reset copy, untapping all lands you control.
Repeat from step 3.
Once you have infinite mana, you can cast Lightning Bolt by paying {R}, dealing 3 damage to any target.
Holding priority, cast Reiterate with buyback by paying {4}{R}{R}, creating a copy of Lightning Bolt.
Resolve the Lightning Bolt copy, dealing 3 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 7.
